verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a SaaS platform like Google Workspace, but nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or push-notification channels. The cited items cover admin APIs, reports, alerts viewing, and Apps Script automation, none of which is an event subscription a programmatic consumer can receive. Polling-based Reports and Alerts APIs and Apps Script are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
